title: Wealth advisor: sign-in succeeds but Outlook says the mailbox cannot be found
narrative: Sign-ins succeed, and the Exchange incident from this morning (EX-LAB-0002) was restored at 12:30 UTC, before the report. The user is in GRP-LIC-E3-MIGRATION, a staging group that disables EXCHANGE_S_ENTERPRISE during mailbox migration waves; the user was never moved to the standard group after cut-over.

auditEvidence.source: Change: move user from GRP-LIC-E3-MIGRATION to GRP-LIC-E3-STAFF (synthetic)
